significance: A temple complex and ashram at Datia founded in the 1920s by Shree Swami Ji, among the best known shrines of Bagalamukhi, with further temples to Dhumavati, Parashurama, Hanuman and Kal Bhairav and a Sanskrit library.
story: The Vankhandeswar linga within the complex is held by tradition to date from the time of the Mahabharata.
